rule: A locale written in its own script must use that script in every value. Exemptions below are exact and checked in both directions.

untranslatable.ai: An initialism that is written AI in every locale that ships here.
untranslatable.channel_validation_message: Placeholders and punctuation only; there is no prose to translate.
untranslatable.cli_claude_code_codex: Names the CLI and the two tools it wraps; all three are product names.
untranslatable.label_url: An initialism that is written URL in every locale that ships here.
untranslatable.mcp: The Model Context Protocol initialism, written MCP everywhere.
untranslatable.of: A slash separator carrying no words.
untranslatable.ok: The borrowed interjection, written OK in every locale that ships here.
untranslatable.production_origin_api: An initialism that is written API in every locale that ships here.
untranslatable.production_origin_cli: An initialism that is written CLI in every locale that ships here.
untranslatable.url: An initialism that is written URL in every locale that ships here.
untranslatable.url_1: The same initialism with a colon.
